rationale: Closes the -$9,500 cash deficit by extending land scaling to 28-30 plots through Day 16-17 under a strict 10-hand workforce cap that maximizes the 10-order engine limit and yields 4-5 recurring Strawberry flushes on late acreage. It eliminates premature shed dumping by raising the liquidation threshold to >= 8 surplus items, preserving an active buffer to capture 2.0x-3.5x Town Shop premiums while strictly barring slow single-harvest crops that caused Gen 85 to fail. Crucially, it reinstates a 2-cycle Carrot liquidity engine (Days 1-5), deploys a Day 23-27 rapid Carrot cash-out on open acreage, and decouples harvesting from watering to eradicate micro-dispatch deadlocks.
